answer: Numbered copper markers line a summit trail, each engraved with one line of a fable in order; the holder photographs each marker in sequence with the date, while the keeper logs the order at the trailhead. Two verifiers return within 24h, walk the same trail, and match the fable order and marker numbers; a marker moved out of order or a duplicate number locks and burns the deposit; 100 fakes need 100 sets of copper markers and 100 summit climbs.
